name: NEXTDC A1 Adelaide

address.note: corner Frome and Pirie Streets; NEXTDC's 2022 announcement and SCAP-era reports give 211 Pirie Street (sources 6,7) - same corner site

lat.note: Geocoded 2026-09-27 from '125 Frome Street, Adelaide SA 5000' with the ArcGIS World Geocoder (PointAddress, score 100). Cross-check: the OpenStreetMap building footprint ('NextDC A1, 125, Frome Street, Adelaide, South Australia, 500') is 1m away.

builder.note: per building certifier BCA Concepts project page ('BUILDER Lendlease'); not confirmed by NEXTDC or Lendlease

mw_it.note: tech specs: 'Total power planned 5MW', 'IT load target capacity of 5 MW'. Announced in Feb 2022 as up to 10 MW (source 6). FY26 results (source 9): 'Additional 2MW in progress to support AI deployment'; datacentermap now lists 6 MW.

cost_aud_m.note: '$100 million data centre' (InDaily 2024); DTI 2022: 'in excess of $100 million' (source 3). Building certifier BCA Concepts gives 'project value $80M' (source 8), likely construction value.

pathway.value: Development application under the Planning, Development and Infrastructure Act 2016 (Capital City Zone), SCAP as relevant authority
pathway.note: planning report by State planning officer to SCAP; applicant's consultant Urbis

reference.note: DA number not found (SCAP / PlanSA pages return 403)

determined.note: SCAP was to assess the 6-storey, 34 m proposal on Wed 14 Dec 2022 with an officer recommendation to approve (source 7); decision and date not verified

jobs_construction.note: DTI states 150 jobs, not split between construction and operations

jobs_construction_other.note: DTI SA: 'investing in excess of $100 million in a state-of-the-art data centre, creating 150 jobs for South Australians' - not split construction/operational

construction_start.note: DTI (Feb 2022): 'Work will commence in the second half of 2022'; Dec 2022 InDaily: NEXTDC expected to begin development in FY23. Actual start not found.

open_questions: SCAP DA number and decision date not verified (planning pages 403)
scope: 5 MW design (at threshold); FY26 says additional 2MW in progress
